name: claw-way-django deployment readiness (local fixture)
notes: Same assertions as the production plan, restricted to the loopback fixture used for the failure -> repair -> pass demonstration.

checks.proves: the application itself reports status=ok, not merely a proxy answering
the responding process is the Django app, not a static fallback or a sibling service
the readiness document asserts a database backend of postgresql

does_not_prove: that the readiness check actually queries the database — the field is self-reported
that migrations have run, or that they ran for this release
that background workers, queues or cron are alive
that the deployed image corresponds to any particular git revision
that a customer-facing page renders the new build
that provisioning, billing or authentication work
that TLS, DNS or the reverse proxy in front of the app are configured correctly
